company_name: The University of Electro-Communications, Yamaguchi Miyashita Kaizu Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: High — The University of Electro-Communications focuses on advanced semiconductor research, particularly in quantum nanostructures and thin film technologies.
summary: The University of Electro-Communications, through its Miyashita Kaizu Laboratory, is engaged in the research and development of semiconductor quantum nanostructure fabrication and thin film manipulation technologies. Their work includes crystal growth for high-density InAsSb quantum dots and nanowires, with applications in optoelectronic devices such as lasers and solar cells.
capabilities: Crystal growth technology for high-density InAsSb quantum dots on GaAs substrates
Crystal growth technology for high-density InAsSb quantum nanowires on Si substrates
Thin film manipulation technology for epitaxial layers
